## Activity

During October 2020, Central Eye Clinic recorded 105 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. No operational issue was identified as affecting the overall capture activity.

The reported total represents all captures submitted by the site during the month. Records were available for image-quality review and subsequent grading in accordance with the usual workflow.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 1 ungradable image from the 105 captures. The ungradable rate was 1.0. This indicates that the large majority of images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable result should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention to any recurring factors that may affect image usability.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates that grading was completed with a short turnaround during October 2020. The site’s activity, image-quality results and grading outcomes should continue to be reviewed through routine reporting, with any changes in performance considered alongside local staffing and session arrangements.
